subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When proposal review demand is computed, the review path shall join the actual `skip`, `standard`, or `deep` band projected by impl-review from the merge lane's risk class with the planned assurance under this closed floor: `ordinary` requires at least one `standard` model-backed assurance pass, `elevated` requires at least one `deep` model-backed assurance pass, and `critical` requires at least two mutually blind `deep` model-backed assurance passes; an actual `deep` band shall raise an `ordinary` pass to `deep`, and no actual band shall reduce planned depth or pass count. An assurance pass is a top-level review of one exact proposal revision and is distinct from any scope-locked remediation re-review inside that pass.
rationale: model-backed review is a universal quality floor, while greater consequence must monotonically add scrutiny without creating a second proposal-risk classifier or miscounting remediation as independent assurance
fit_criterion: the complete assurance×band matrix yields `ordinary×skip→standard×1`, `ordinary×standard→standard×1`, `ordinary×deep→deep×1`, every `elevated` cell→`deep×1`, and every `critical` cell→`deep×2`; zero cells produce zero passes; every pass resolves through the review-role mapping; critical passes bind the same exact revision, use distinct top-level context identities, receive no other pass's session, candidates, findings, verdict, or output, and a remediation re-review never satisfies the second-pass requirement
